name: KIC 8176905
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 20.1 solar radii and 1.14 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 8176905 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 20.0938 +/- 0.4007

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 8176905 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.143 +/- 0.0496

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 8176905 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4420.2793 +/- 41.3271

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 8176905 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 1.8726 +/- 0.0039

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 20 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.14 solar masses and 20.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,420 K at its surface.
